cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Calm About the Impossible
cards.instruction: Remain perfectly calm around impossible events while becoming increasingly alarmed by ordinary details.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. The table can float while we pack. That wet cup needs a mat.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's at the ceiling. I'll pull it down.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Wait! You'll slide the cup across the polish. Get the stepladder.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll climb up. I've still got my muddy boots on.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Boots off! Socks too if they're damp. We are not adding footprints to that water ring.

mechanism: A treats levitating furniture calmly while escalating its pupil old carelessness with polish into an urgent footwear correction.
confusable: Not alarm about the floating object: the worry is a water ring, scratches, then muddy or damp footprints.
comparison: Etiquette anxiety with a guest versus material-care anxiety with a former moving pupil.
seedUse: D165 floating table/cup/mat/ladder/boots; S05 old furniture handling instruction.
